runtime: Next.js production / isolated PostgreSQL / two instances / restricted application role

results.name: guests and bad origins cannot write or read private resources
onboarding gates interactions and supports partial save, resume and skip
post idempotency, author isolation and historical character identity
comments use independent characters and are idempotent and private to their author for deletion
likes are account-unique, reversible and reject nonboolean state
pagination is stable, filter-bound and search uses actual database content
poll options seal on publish; one account has one vote and expiration is enforced
rating edits do not add voters; deletion and 5-voter threshold are correct
concurrent daily claims across instances grant exactly ten for Beijing date
concurrent 8+8 spending from ten allows one success and preserves two
post gifts atomically transfer to real author, prevent self gifts and deduplicate retries
ledger insert failure rolls back balances, operation and idempotency record together
hot rankings deduplicate commenters and exclude self interactions and old activity
recommendation changes with interests, has guest fallback and version metadata
image uploads decode safely, reject forgery and remain owner-only until published
ordinary users cannot use management; requests and reports reach the review queue
audit failure rolls back moderation and ordinary actors cannot forge a manager
admin maintains public people/topics and audits application approvals
admin avatar upload preserves attribution and ordinary users cannot replace public portraits
valid MP4 is probed and served with ranges; forgery and mixed attachments are rejected
recovery codes are hashed, single-use, work across instances and revoke old sessions
hidden posts vanish from direct URLs, quotes, comments, media, hot lists and recommendations
bans revoke existing credentials and unbanning never restores them
public users and own activity expose no private wallet, role or credentials
database disconnect rejects community reads and writes and recovers without losing sessions
lost HTTP success response can be retried without duplicate debit or publication
release root, isolated demo, public policies and health endpoints are available
blocking is private, persists across instances and hides content, quotes and media
blocked accounts cannot bypass interaction rules by changing figures or endpoints
account deletion validates password and confirmation and rolls back on failure
permanent erasure removes identity, credentials, content, polls and media without rewriting ledgers
